known_limitations: Formal state covers only externally reconstructible governed configuration (completed nodes, promotion, completion); artifact-level and budget-level state are not yet folded into refinement.
Historical ledger adapters encode a deterministic but interpretive mapping; mapping records are committed, and semantic fidelity of the mapping is an assumption.
Non-authority labels (observe/propose/validate/reject/consult/return/persist/reconstruct) are wildcard self-loops: refinement does not restrict which actor emits them.

Filesystem-scope attenuation accepts protected-path-disjoint sibling delegation inside the parent workspace envelope (the lineage's governed law); a stricter pure-containment semantics would fail the historical K1->K2 and K2->K3 grants.
Bisimulation is implemented for finite explicitly-modeled LTSs with naive fixpoint iteration; adequate for fixture scale, not optimized.
Model-call budget consumption is not tracked by the runtime trace semantics (budgets are checked only as contract attenuation axes).
unproven_claims: Arbitrary infinite Creator Closure (only bounded hat_kappa witnesses are checked).
Semantic equivalence of hidden model/epistemic states across sessions.
Formal correctness of Claude Code itself, or that its implementation globally refines this model.
Universal decidability of bisimulation for unrestricted future models.
Full Tarski convergence of arbitrary Decomposer/Composer synthesis.
